title: Emergency Call Turns Into Something No Officer Expected
description:
On May 21st, 2024. A troubled woman called 911 after her troubled fiancé left a troubling voicemail to her. Police responded trying to figure out what was going on, and begin looking for her to provide immediate support and help that she needed. Once they found her, the woman immediately lost her cool when she spotted the police, going as far to spit on one of the officer. 

*If you or someone you know is in need of mental health support, help is available. Start by reaching out to a trusted healthcare professional, such as your primary care doctor, who can provide referrals to mental health specialists like psychologists, psychiatrists, or counselors.

 Many communities offer mental health services through local clinics, hospitals, and nonprofit organizations. Contact a mental health crisis line or emergency services in your area for immediate assistance during a crisis. In the U.S., you can reach the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline by dialing 988, available 24/7 for confidential support. 

Additionally, many resources are accessible online, including virtual therapy platforms and mental health apps that provide counseling and self-help tools. Don’t hesitate to seek support—mental health is just as important as physical health, and help is always within reach.* 

*Please note that this video is to show the interaction between the officers and the woman, it is not meant to ridicule her in any sort of way. We hope she gets the support or help that she needs.*


We give video credit to one of our viewers (Edan) who sent in the BWC footage to us.
